start_enabled.description: Whether to start the darkstat service on boot.

items.description: Network interface(s) to monitor (e.g., eth0, enp0s3, any).

interfaces.description: List of interfaces to capture traffic from. Use 'any' to capture from all interfaces.

bind_address.description: IP address for the web UI to listen on. Use '127.0.0.1' to restrict access to localhost.

port.description: TCP port for the web interface. Must be accessible and non-privileged (>1024 recommended).

db_dir.description: Directory where darkstat stores persistent data (hosts, services, etc.).

graph_dir.description: Directory to store daily graph data (if graphing is enabled).

enable_graphing.description: Enable generation of daily traffic graphs.

graph_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain daily graph data before rotation.

max_hosts.description: Maximum number of unique hosts to track in memory and reports.

max_ports.description: Maximum number of TCP/UDP ports to track per host.

enable_compression.description: Enable HTTP compression (gzip) for web interface responses.

enable_dns_lookups.description: Enable reverse DNS lookups to resolve hostnames. May cause delays and increase load.

extra_options.description: Additional space-separated command-line options for darkstat (e.g., '--no-macs' or '--chroot /var/lib/darkstat').
